releases.title: Through Space and Time
releases.description: A update overhauling various parts of the game to ensure smooth gameplay, new functions, and better capabilities.
changes: Added new skins.
Added a temporary in-game store.
Fixed health and time glitches.
Refurbed UI.
Added ability to sleep and skip to day.
Crop markers appear the same at day and night.
Sprinklers rotate toward the rotation the water is spraying.
Everyone in session follows hosts clock.
The clock is saved between sessions.
Fixed better gunshot sound.
Fixed clouds that appear and dissapear smoothly, behave like real clouds.
Fixed gunshot surface effects to match surface color accurately.

releases.title: Explosions in a barrel
releases.description: A functional update adding new functionalities and patching previous ones, as well as graphics improvements.
changes: Fixed sprinkler issues.
Fixed so light poles actually have lights that glow.
Added a health system and a temporary ragdoll effect upon elimination.
Fixed rotation of character when holding gun.
Added post-processing and further graphics updates.

releases.title: Puff of Air
changes: Fixed issue where time is not synced between players.
Fixed issue where players can fall through the map forever.
Fixed issue where animals behave weirdly and isolated per player.
Fixed issue where the custom roads where glitchy and blurry, as well as having divides.
Fixed issue where a player could access their mailbox from another player's.

releases.title: New Winds
releases.description: A massive update including graphics, gameplay, and functionality overhauls.
changes: A new URP Graphics Engine with original lighting shaders instead of toonish buggy ones.
A day / night system with tuned lighting and graphics has been added.
Contracts via a Contract Board in the middle of the map paying more for tasks that are more specific.
Weapon and Shooting functionality has been added toward experimental animals.
The settings screen is now centered and aligned.
The player transitions to a stop instead of snapping when opening menus.
IL2CCP Source Code protection against reverse engineering has been implemented.
